# Contributing to Darrell TW Blog

Thanks for helping improve Darrell TW Blog. Keep contributions focused on the blog, its Astro migration, and its supporting content.

## Issues

Report bugs and request features through the [Darrell TW Blog issue tracker](https://github.com/Darrellwan/darrelltw-blog/issues). Include the affected route or file, reproduction steps, and relevant screenshots or logs.

## Pull requests

1. Explain the problem and the intended change.
2. Keep unrelated formatting and generated files out of the pull request.
3. Run the relevant local checks before opening the pull request.
4. Link the related issue when one exists.
